verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents cross-meeting search. The pricing page lists "Meeting search" and the homepage says it can search all team conversations. The transcripts API supports keyword search across meeting titles and spoken words, and AskFred can answer questions across multiple meetings. However, nothing in the evidence shows that search covers summaries or notes, or that a user can jump to the exact timestamp where something was said. missing for 10: jump-to-moment/timestamp navigation in search results, explicit search over summaries and notes, independent or hands-on corroboration of in-app search quality.
